Hi Elaine / Procurement team,

Following up from our demo last week — BrightAxis is ready to renew the committed capacity and add an additional 2 GPU units for Q4. To keep the renewal on the August cadence we need two procurement approvals on your side: the financial PO and the security onboarding signoff.

What we can provide today:
- Updated SOW (attached) reflecting +2 GPUs and a 12-month extension
- PO template (attached) prefilled with the final pricing and billing contact
- SOC2 attestation (attached) and a short list of our SIEM/audit log export options

Can you confirm the following so we can sequence the approvals?
1) Procurement contact who will issue the Purchase Order (name + email)
2) Security contact to review the SOC2 packet and sign the onboarding checklist
3) Target PO date — can BrightAxis commit to a PO by Sep 3?

If you prefer, we can split the flow: finance issues the PO while security completes the onboarding in parallel — that will let us preserve the committed pricing.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Renewal_v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB); PO_Template_BrightAxis.xlsx (Excel, 14KB); SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the docs. Quick answers:
- PO owner: Me and our AP lead (ap.ops@brightaxis.com) will issue the PO.
- Security reviewer: Miguel Santos (m.santos@brightaxis.com) — he'll need the SOC2 pack and a short onboarding checklist.
- PO target: Sep 6 is safer for us, but we can try Sep 3 if there are no further redlines.

A couple of asks from my side before we circulate the PO:
- Can you provide a one-page amendment showing only the term/pricing delta for legal? That speeds approvals.
- We need to confirm your data retention window and export options for logs — Miguel asked for that specifically.

If you can get the one-page delta and the log-export options to Miguel by EOD tomorrow, we'll aim for Sep 3.

Best,
Elaine Park
